[[File:FusionXLR8RCannon.png|thumb|right|250px]]
The '''Fusion Accelerator Cannon''' was a prototype [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] that was used on the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] as the ship's strongest weapon available.

The final recording of [[Technician/Legends|Weapons Tech Chief]] [[Yan Dom Guez]], speaking about the prototype, was salvaged from the ruins of the [[B'Ya Weapons Testing Facility]].

==The Battle of Kamino==
{{Main|Assault on Kamino}}
{{Quote|Direct hit! The cannon's offline, we're dead in the water without it!|Rahm Kota|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
With the impending threat from the Imperial space force, General [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] ordered the [[Subject 1138|clone of Galen Marek]] to find and operate the Fusion Accelerator Cannon, the strongest weapon in the ship, in order to destroy their enemies.

[[File:Fusion_Accelerator_Cannon.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Salvation''{{'s}} Fusion Accelerator Cannon during the [[Assault on Kamino]].]]
The clone succeeded to find the large weapon, however, the area was also ravaged by Imperial forces during a fight against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldiers. Just in time, as Starkiller arrived at that area, an ion blast from a distant [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] caused the cannon itself to malfunction. With the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the clone was able to re-activate it by means of conducting [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] to the generators and was able to fire a single powerful shot at the distant Star Destroyer, blasting the battleship in half and scattering the remnants everywhere.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Fusion Accelerator Cannon first appeared in [[LucasArts]]' [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.
